Voxel Carving originates from the field of multi-view stereo and volumetric reconstruction.
It is based on the concept of "Space Carving," where the volume is constrained by the silhouettes or depth maps of multiple views.

Early hardware-accelerated approaches were explored by Culbertson [Culbertson99] and Sainz et al. [SBS02], while theoretical foundations were laid by researchers like Seitz and Dyer [ProDy, S3, unofficial].
